==Behind the scenes==
This is likely the same [[Bothan safehouse]] as seen in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire novel'']] and [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic series]], but it is not specifically stated.
